subject: Different standard deviation results for  strucured and unstructured spatial Effects using INLA and BayesX

messages.author: 96e275f43eafb053
messages.subject: Different standard deviation results for  strucured and unstructured spatial Effects using INLA and BayesX
parts:
Hi,

I am carrying out an analysis on spatial generalized linear mixed model using MCMC implemented in R2BayesX and INLA. The model had probit link.

My aim of study was to compare the results and computation time of the two approaches.

Both methods have generated similar results except that the posterior means and standard deviations (SD)  for spatial and temporal effects are different.

Example for structured spatial effect the mean and SD  for INLA  and  R2BayesX were ( 120.7,592.82 )  and ( 0.14,0.25) respectively

I had set INLA hyperpriors 0.001 which are default for R2BayesX.

What is the probable reason for the differences considering I have specified similar hyperpriors.

Thanks.
